Eligibility of Tenderer : 1. The minimum number of years of general experience of the Tenderer in the construction
works as Prime Contractor or Subcontractor or Management Contractor shall be 05
(Five)years.
2. A satisfactory completion of similar works of at least ( Supply, Installation, Testing & Commissioning of at least 2 lift) by Tk 150
(one hundred fifty) lac under single contract over a period of 5 (Five) years shall be required in any government, semi-government
or autonomous body.
3. The required average annual construction turnover shall be greater than Tk 5 (Five) Crore over best three (3) years in the last
five (5) years.
4. The minimum amount of liquid assets or working capital or credit facilities of the Tenderer shall be Tk Tk 2.5 (Two & half) Crore.
5. The tenderer should have updated trade license, TIN and VAT certificate and incorporation certificate.
6. The tenderer should have minimum one work done certificate with E-gp ID should be submitted in last 5 years.
7. The bidder must have Electrical A-B-C licences & Supervisory licences from electrification Board.
8. others qualification criteria as stated in TDS.
